objective: Fix dark-mode unreadable notification titles/body/timestamps and mismatched status bar in screenshot; restore 12-palette WCAG AA readability and compact executive Notifications list without changing notification privacy, deep links, PTT, alerts, or other screens.
productionBaselineEvidence: Verified Android staging-user release PR #830, commit ab3ed7c375b09b31dcac2369c106eba4bd8a6ca0, Expo update 01a1df87-139b-7da4-9e69-4e5ed36024df, workflow 43721789926, signed staging client runtime 1.3.2. No production changes authorized.
chosenApproach: Convert Notifications from legacy fixed light text + static screen canvas to existing useThemedShared and semantic palette text, with theme-aware status bar and cluster action buttons; remove decorative bell and duplicate 99 badge and replace giant full-width bulk read button with compact 44px header action.
selectionRationale: Existing global Card responds to Night Pine while Notifications text does not. A narrow route/theme-token fix avoids touching protected notification data path and native runtime.
alternativeApproaches: Force all notification cards white in dark mode (rejected: inconsistent night theme and status bar).
Globally change legacy colors.text for every component (rejected: uncontrolled cross-app regression).
Change only the existing Notifications route and associated action controls (selected).
preserveBehaviors: Private notifications are still fetched by user_id with RLS, faith filtering, and PTT incoming exclusion.
Notification mark-all, individual read state, cluster join decisions, exact deep links and activity notification count remain unchanged.
No database/backend/AdMob/media/Kingdom/Connect/PTT logic, native packages, permissions, session boundaries, production or Play updates.
Readable normal-length and long Filipino/English notification bodies without cutting the text or shrinking fonts.
Physical device visual acceptance waived by owner; automated source contrast, tests and Android typecheck remain mandatory.
acceptanceChecks: Twelve palette title/body/time text-to-card backgrounds each meet WCAG AA >=4.5:1.
Status bar icon style follows screen canvas on Night Pine, Graphite, Midnight and all light themes.
Executive header replaces giant Mark all banner with 44px action and list row separators without hiding any notification body.
Exact source privacy/mark read/deep links/cluster actions preserved with focused regression tests.
Source branch compared against immutable staging PR #830; no unilateral production or stale staging release.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Notifications route and join decision card styles currently mix fixed light-theme text with dynamically dark Card surfaces and require a scoped app runtime visual fix.
preservedBehaviors: Keep current Notifications query, read/update/deep link routing, notification counts and Cluster decisions; use only palette semantic styles.
